chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Jariri, from Abdul-Mumin Al-Ansari, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Oil is the anointing oil of the righteous and the condiment of the best. Blessing is in it when facing forward and blessing is in it when facing backward; immerse it in the Holy [oil] twice.'

key_terms.إِدَامُ: Condiment / side dish / food that accompanies the main meal
key_terms.الزَّيْتُ: Oil (specifically olive oil in this context)
key_terms.الْقُدْسِ: The Holy / holiness (often referring to olive oil or a specific sacred substance)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and physical significance of olive oil in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Baqir (AS) elevates olive oil as a divine sustenance for the righteous, linking its physical properties to spiritual purity. The instruction to 'dip in al-Quds' (the Holy) twice reflects the Shia tradition of using olive oil for ritual anointing (dabagh) and highlights its status as a blessed food that bridges bodily health and spiritual devotion.
